overview_description.description: Kalam Labs is a live game streaming platform at the intersection of K-12 learning and multiplayer gaming. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, United States.

awards.description: Kalam Labs was recognized in Forbes' 2022 30 Under 30 Asia list in the Consumer Technology category for its work in building a STEM metaverse for kids.

product.name: Nano Flight Controller
product.description: A custom-designed microcontroller for drones, enabling advanced flight control and mission execution via smartphone.

product.name: KL-Quadcopter
product.description: A specialized microcontroller for quadcopters supporting multiple sensors and high-speed flight control.

product.name: KL-Fixed Wing
product.description: A microcontroller for fixed-wing aircraft drones, enabling custom missions and smartphone control.

product.name: Quadcopter Kit
product.description: A kit for assembling a quadcopter drone with smartphone control, offering 15 minutes of flight time and 200 meters range.

product.name: Pakshi Fixed Wing Kit
product.description: A kit to fabricate a fixed-wing aircraft drone controlled via smartphone, with 10 minutes flight time and 100 meters range.

product.name: Stratospheric Glider
product.description: A drone designed to fly in near-earth space and land autonomously, used for high-altitude missions.
